name: License Manifest Viewer
blurb: packages in an image grouped by license, with GPLv3 and other copyleft flagged
intro: Reads a Yocto license.manifest (or an SPDX 2.x JSON/tag-value or SPDX 3.0 SBOM), parses each LICENSE expression the way oe.license does, maps obsolete names through SPDXLICENSEMAP and groups the packages by license family. INCOMPATIBLE_LICENSE is applied as bitbake applies it (first acceptable OR branch, the three GPLv3 wildcards, exceptions), so you see what an image would lose before you build.

usage: Give the license.manifest text (or SPDX JSON / tag-value) in manifest, optionally INCOMPATIBLE_LICENSE and INCOMPATIBLE_LICENSE_EXCEPTIONS. It returns counts per license family, a per-license table, the packages INCOMPATIBLE_LICENSE would exclude (and which exceptions let in), the recipes that need a GPL/LGPL/MPL source offer (also as text), and warnings for GPLv3 content, unknown licenses and bad expressions. Use it to audit an image before release or to preview a GPLv3-free build.
sources: poky scarthgap meta/classes-recipe/license_image.bbclass write_license_files() (manifest format, exceptions)

poky meta/lib/oe/license.py (expression grammar, license_ok fnmatch, flattened_licenses) and meta/classes-global/license.bbclass (incompatible_pkg_license, expand_wildcard_licenses, canonical_license)
GPL-3.0 section 6 (Installation Information); family grouping is this tool's triage reading, not legal advice
